title: After Learning Father Doesn't Have Long
description:
Two months since you learned your father doesn't have much time left.
You'd been carrying that knowledge.
Today a call came from him.

choices.result_text:
You picked up.
His voice was weaker than before.
Because you knew — this time you talked for a long time.

You called back later.
He was already asleep.
You knew — and still let the time slip.

title: After Exiting the Startup
description:
Two months since you pulled out of the startup entirely.
The decision hadn't been easy.
Today you heard news about the company.

choices.result_text:
Things hadn't gone well there.
Getting out when you did was right.
Knowing when to leave — is just as important as knowing when to go in.

Still some regret.
But the decision was made.
Regret and a decision — can coexist.

title: Two Months Since Founding
description:
Two months since you started the company.
It had been quieter than expected.
Today, for the first time, someone reached out from outside.

choices.result_text:
You set one up.
From a state where no one knew — someone now did.
This is how a startup begins.

You looked into them first.
People who approach early-stage founders — have their reasons.
Checking before meeting was the right move.

title: After the Startup Started to Grow
description:
Three months since the startup started growing noticeably.
It had been a busy stretch.
Today the first investment inquiry came in.

choices.result_text:
You met.
The growth had brought this contact.
Investors only show up where something is growing.

You said it was too early.
Taking investment isn't always better the faster it comes.
Receiving it when you're ready tends to work better.

title: After Taking the New Job
description:
Two months since you made the move and joined the new company.
It had been an unfamiliar environment.
Today a colleague from the old place reached out.

choices.result_text:
You answered warmly.
They asked 'How's it going?'
Leaving — means most when you can answer that question well.

You said 'Things are good.'
That the move had been right — you could tell by how natural those words felt.

title: After Turning Down the Offer
description:
Two months since you turned down the job offer.
You'd been wondering if that was right.
Today news came about that company.

choices.result_text:
Things hadn't gone well there.
Declining had been right.
But it was a decision made without that information — the timing was luck.

choices.text: Still feel like you might have missed out
choices.result_text:
You still wondered.
Even if things went badly there — the possibility of something better remained.
A decision's weight isn't measured only by the outcome.

title: After Hesitating and Staying
description:
Two months since you hesitated and decided to stay.
The offer had come back to mind sometimes.
Today you heard how that company had done.

choices.result_text:
Things hadn't gone well there.
The hesitation had kept you — and that turned out right.
Even when the reason behind a decision differs from the outcome — the outcome is still the outcome.

Things hadn't gone badly there.
The hesitation may have let an opportunity pass.
Hesitation from fear — is worth looking at more honestly next time.

title: After Being Headhunted
description:
Two months since the headhunting offer came in.
You'd made a decision.
Today the outcome of that decision came through.

choices.result_text:
It worked out.
Being headhunted — means the market has recognized you.
That recognition matters more than the decision itself.

choices.text: Look back regardless of what you decided
choices.result_text:
You looked back.
A headhunting offer creates options.
Having options — means you're standing somewhere different.

title: After Exaggerating at the Reunion
description:
Two months since you stretched the truth at the class reunion.
That night came back to you sometimes.
Today you ran into someone who was there.

choices.result_text:
You talked naturally.
They likely still remembered.
A lie doesn't disappear — it stays in the other person's memory.

choices.text: Only build on the parts that were true
choices.result_text:
You kept to what was actually true.
Pulling gradually from the exaggeration toward the real thing.
One way to make a lie into the truth — is to make it true.

title: After Coming Clean to a Friend
description:
A month since you came clean with a friend.
Things had felt different since.
Today they reached out.

choices.result_text:
You met.
Being honest had made this meeting possible.
If you'd kept it hidden — this call wouldn't have come.

choices.text: Ask what the message is about first
choices.result_text:
You asked what was going on.
They said 'Nothing. Just missed you.'
Being honest — had made you someone they just wanted to see.

title: After Deleting the Gambling Apps
description:
Two months since you deleted all the gambling apps.
Your hand had reached for them at first.
Today you looked back at the two months.

choices.result_text:
You hadn't touched them in two months.
Deleting them had created a barrier.
Removing access — works better than willpower.

There had been moments.
But the apps weren't there.
Deleting them — had stopped you at the moments of wavering.
It had been a choice made for your future self.

title: After Hitting Rock Bottom
description:
Three months since you hit rock bottom.
Looking back still felt heavy.
Today you compared then to now.

choices.result_text:
Things had changed.
Knowing where the bottom is — means knowing you can't go further down.
Hitting bottom — is what created the direction.

Not fully there yet.
But the direction had shifted.
Feeling like you need to be fully recovered — that standard makes it harder.

title: The Promise to Your Father
description:
Three months since you promised your father you'd make it to Gangnam.
That promise had stayed heavy.
Today a text came from him. 'How are you doing.'

choices.result_text:
You said 'Yeah — working hard.'
He said 'Good.'
A short exchange — but the promise had made it different.

You told him specifically how far you'd come.
He took a long time reading it.
Someone who takes a promise seriously — makes the one receiving it take it seriously too.

title: After Acting on the Gray Tip
description:
Two months since you used the borderline information and made a profit.
The result had been good.
Today a similar tip came in again.

choices.result_text:
You turned it down.
Once was luck. Twice becomes habit.
A good outcome doesn't justify the same action again.

You used it again.
A good result doesn't mean the method was right.
The better the results keep coming — the greater the exposure risk grows alongside them.

title: After Taking the High Road
description:
Two months since you chose the harder right over the easier wrong.
In the short term it had cost you.
Today something came back.

choices.result_text:
It came back.
Not right away — but it came.
The results of doing right tend to arrive late. That's what makes them hard to believe in.

Still nothing.
But there was also something you hadn't lost.
Conscience — is the easiest thing to sell, and the most expensive to buy back.
